name: OpenCloudAgents
friendlyName: Open Cloud Agents: Autonomous Cloud Governance Gate
description: Deterministic pre-flight linting, blast-radius risk tiering, and autonomous triage gate for cloud infrastructure.
author: Open Cloud Agents Authors

inputs.name: risk_tier
inputs.label: Risk Tier
inputs.helpMarkDown: Changeset risk classification tier (auto, tier0, tier1, tier2).

inputs.name: fail_on_p0
inputs.label: Fail Pipeline on P0/P1 Findings
inputs.helpMarkDown: Block the build pipeline if unresolved critical or high severity security/architecture findings are detected.

inputs.name: offline_mode
inputs.label: Air-Gapped Offline Mode
inputs.helpMarkDown: Run strictly offline with zero external network egress.

inputs.name: sarif_output
inputs.label: SARIF Output Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Destination path for generated SARIF 2.1.0 report.
